read:from-outside.summary:
Case page. The first screen says well how far it is checked. It says what the page is only in the work's own words (Ren, step 8, the plan, Lean unglossed, "the map"), and five minutes is short for it. A reader with a case can use questions 1, 3 and 8 as written. Questions 2, 4, 5, 7 and 9 would be misread (C1 to C4, C6). Questions 4b, 6 and 7 cannot be read until "rule" and "share" are said (C5). It promises more than the model gives at question 4: growth now is taken for growth at every step, and a count of steps for a forecast.

Direction page. "What we have found so far" marks its dates, but he could not see from it alone what is still given. It mixes 15 and 16 November inside one bullet. It leaves out four givens: the ceiling, the assumed regime, the level not being read, every need met at the start. It tells two worked courses as a law. It nests the lock inside a model that has no lock. It does not say that a test frozen beforehand still fires. Terms he would stop on: "the ceiling", "a state its level can hold", "the proviso", "off that", "one step read from two ends", "the gap".

Not checked: the plan and the board beyond the one plan sentence in C3.

TEXTS NOT READY: fix first D2, D5, D1, C1, C2; then D3, D4, C3, C4.
